scenes.text: Someone on this island left you a warning. So you write back.
You're shipwrecked. Every night, someone switches off your emergency beacon. Last night, they left you food, and one word.
Right under it, you scratch three words. Who are you?
Then you build a lookout, at the top of the tallest palm.
Notches for your feet. A platform of lashed sticks. A roof of fronds.
From up here, you can see the whole island. And the reef, wrapped all the way around it.
And that night, you watch the beach.
Nothing. Except, for a second, a tiny light, deep in the jungle.
At sunrise, you climb down. There's a new message.
And next to it, someone left a tiny carved boat.
Whoever they are, they've been here a long time. And they know something you don't. What do you do? Top comment decides part four.
